subject: Television & Streaming
title: Dr. Gregory House: Brilliance and Cruelty
description: A fast breakdown of Dr. Gregory House: Brilliance and Cruelty for builders.

hook.text: Dr. House limped through hallways, insulted patients, and popped Vicodin.

buildup.text: Hugh Laurie played House as a man who saw medicine as a puzzle.

discovery.text: House was modeled on Sherlock Holmes.

twist.text: The show asked whether a brilliant doctor who treats patients cruelly is better than a kind doctor who misses diagnoses.

climax.text: Dr. House proved that audiences love competence.

punchline.text: The worst bedside manner in TV history saved the most lives.

quiz.question: What literary character was Dr. House deliberately modeled after?
